sources.snippet: MobileNetV2 with DeepLabV3+ MobileNet V2 model pre-trained on PASCAL VOC at resolution 513x513. It was introduced in MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks by Mark Sandler, Andrew Howard, Menglong Zhu, Andrey Zhmoginov, Liang-Chieh Chen. It was first released in this repository.
